title: Reliable mobile press-and-hold steering via robust pointer/touch-safe control handling

requirements.summary: Ensure mobile Left/Right (and Brake) on-screen buttons use press-and-hold shared control state and always clear it on release/cancel to prevent stuck steering and unwanted browser gestures.
acceptanceCriteria: On a mobile device, pressing and holding the Left button moves the car left by at least one lane (when possible).
On a mobile device, pressing and holding the Right button moves the car right by at least one lane (when possible).
If the user lifts their finger outside the button area (touch cancel / pointer cancel), the corresponding control state is cleared and the car does not keep steering.
The on-screen controls do not trigger unwanted page scrolling/zooming while playing (no accidental browser gestures caused by the control presses).

file_operations.description: Refactor Left/Right/Brake button input handling to be press-and-hold reliable: set shared control state true on press, and always clear it on pointerup/pointercancel/lostpointercapture (and on component unmount). Use pointer capture and a window-level safety clear while a control is held so releasing outside the button reliably clears. Add gesture-prevention (preventDefault/stopPropagation where appropriate) and Tailwind classes (e.g., touch-action disabling / overscroll prevention / user-select none) on the controls overlay/buttons to avoid scroll/zoom during gameplay. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the game container (or a wrapper around the active play area) applies mobile gesture suppression while playing (e.g., Tailwind touch-action and overscroll behavior classes) so on-screen control presses don’t scroll/zoom the page. Keep gameplay logic unchanged aside from preventing unwanted browser gestures.

requirements.summary: Update touch control event handling to use robust mobile-safe events (pointer events and/or touch start/end/cancel) without regressing keyboard controls or changing gameplay logic.
acceptanceCriteria: TouchControls provides consistent behavior on Android Chrome: press sets control true, release sets it false, and cancel sets it false.
No regression: keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight controls continue to work as before.

file_operations.description: Replace current mixed onTouch/onMouse handlers with a single robust pointer-events-based implementation for Left/Right (and Brake): onPointerDown sets control true, onPointerUp sets false, and onPointerCancel/lostpointercapture sets false. Ensure the implementation is resilient across touch and pointer input and does not change movement/scoring/collision logic beyond making controls responsive. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Review and (if needed) minimally adjust control-state updating to ensure no regression for keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/space behavior while mobile controls are improved (e.g., avoid unintended persistence and ensure cleanup remains correct). Keep existing gameplay semantics intact.
